title: Submit
description: You send us your case — as much or as little as you know. Our team reaches out to understand it properly before anything else.
note: We ask before we assume. Context comes before strategy.

title: Strategize
description: We prepare a personal strategy built specifically around your situation, and present it to you directly.
note: No pressure, no prepayment. You see the plan before you commit to anything.

title: Decide
description: The decision to move forward is entirely yours — and it's the only thing that starts the work.
note: Full cooperation begins only once you say yes.
